evidence_items.explanation: The researchers describe broad capabilities and an early, incomplete form of AGI while also documenting limitations. Their experiments concern a development version, and their interpretation does not establish competence on arbitrary tasks.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not supply a shared threshold separating broad but imperfect capabilities from AGI.
Neither cited evaluation conclusively establishes or rules out the ordinary breadth of competence meant by arbitrary tasks.
